claim: The National Institute on Minority Health and Health Disparities (NIMHD) has developed a framework to guide and orient research into health disparities and minority health.
source: The National Institute on Minority Health and Health Disparities (NIMHD) has developed a framework to guide and orient research into health disparities and minority health.

claim: The NIMHD framework depicts different domains of influence (such as biological and behavioral) and different levels of influence (such as individual and interpersonal).
